newsitem.title: USA: IMF seen approving $390 mln loan for Egypt Friday.
newsitem.headline: IMF seen approving $390 mln loan for Egypt Friday.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund is expected to approve on Friday a $390 million loan for Egypt aimed at helping the country carry out an ambitious economic program, monetary sources said on Wednesday.
Approval of the two-year, stand-by loan should pave the way for a decision by the Paris Club of creditor countries to write off $4 billion of Egypt's debt.
Egyptian government newspapers on Wednesday quoted Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid as saying that IMF approval of the country's reform program was "wholehearted."
International monetary sources here, who declined to be named, said the Egyptian government has done much this year to put its economy back on track and that more is planned.
"It is an extensive program of structural reforms, basically involving the whole economy," one source said.
Among measures planned are large-scale privatisation, trade liberalization, widespread deregulation, fiscal sector reform, including the tax system, and financial sector reform.
